biotools.summary: Lab Integrated Data (LabID) is an open-source web-based platform for research data management in life science institutes, featuring sample and dataset management, an inventory management system and an electronic lab notebook. LabID allows recording extensive experimental information about the provenance of data (samples, reagents, instrument, protocols, assay parameters) and is designed to help individual scientists, research groups and core facilities better manage, annotate and share their research according to FAIR principles.
